title: When Safety Becomes a Vulnerability: Exploiting LLM Alignment Homogeneity for Transferable Blocking in RAG

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the attack success rate and strategy preference of injecting adversarial RAG documents that artificially frame benign queries as promoting hate speech, discrimination, or harmful stereotypes against protected groups (race, gender, religion, etc.) to intentionally trigger the LLM's safety refusal mechanisms.
